ශී ලංකා පජාතාන්තික සමාජවාදී ජනරජෙය් ගැසට් පතය
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) Notice under Section 7 My Reference No.: Ambako/3/1/A/118. Land Ministry Reference No.: 4/3/9/2011/WS/168.

I, hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following land/Servitude Which is required for a public purpose. Description of the land or Servitude to be acquired : Lot No. 241 of Pawalamale Watta below name land in total extent about 0.0090 Hectares, shown in FVP No. 106 Sheet No. 22 Supplement No. 19 and dated 14.03.2016 prepared by the Surveyor General, situated in the village of Pawalamale Watta in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Ambagamuwa, in the District of Nuwara Eliya. Boundaries: North: Lot No. 29; East: Lot No. 29; South: Lot No. 29; West: Lot No. 29.

Claimant’s Name and Address: K. K. Chandradasa, “Chandana”, Bandaranayaka Mawatha, Ginigathhena. All persons interested in the aforesaid land/lands on which a servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at Divisional Secretariat, Ambagamuwa on the 10th day of August, 2016 at 10.00 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before 27th day of July, 2016, the nature of their interests in the land, the perticulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land/servitude, the amount of pensation and the details of the computation of such amount. R. T. P. SUMANASEKARA, Divisional Secretary, Ambagamuwa Koralaya, Ginigathhena. Divisional Secretariat, Ambagamuwa, 24th June, 2016. 07 - 750
